text: Every single plant-based food they tested... had fungus toxins in it.
Do you know what's hiding in your oat milk and veggie burger?
Scientists bought two hundred twelve plant-based products off UK shelves. Burgers, vegan sausages, oat, almond and soy milk.
All two hundred twelve had at least one mycotoxin.
But before you panic... here's the part nobody's posting.
The levels were all below the safety limits.
The real problem is stacking. A little bit, every day, from lots of products... can add up.
And the mold gets in early. On the grains, beans and seeds, in the field and in storage.
Right now, there are no rules for mycotoxins in these newer foods.
Scientists want testing to catch up... before the menu does.
So no, you don't have to quit your oat latte. Just mix up what you eat.
Did this change how you see plant-based food?
